prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in League City, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1116; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep this to the facts of what happened, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision took place?
A: It was on a multi-lane road in League City, Texas, in the right-hand lanes. I was moving over to get into the lane on my right because I needed to make an exit.
Q: What were you doing right before the contact?
A: I checked my mirror, saw the lane looked clear, and signaled. I started to move over slowly.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle at any point?
A: Not in the mirror, no. I felt a bump on the passenger side and then heard scraping. My car drifted a little and I corrected it.
Q: Where did the other vehicle make contact with your car?
A: Along the right side, toward the rear door and the back panel. It was a sideswipe, so it was more of a scrape than a hard hit.
Q: Did you pull over after the contact?
A: Yes, I got onto the shoulder as soon as I could safely do it. The other driver also stopped a short distance ahead.
Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes. I put my right hand out to brace myself when the car jolted, and my wrist took the impact. I was seen at an urgent care clinic that evening and later told the wrist was fractured. I've been wearing a splint and have a follow-up scheduled with a specialist.
Q: Did you have any passengers?
A: No, I was alone in the vehicle.
Q: Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm willing to provide the medical paperwork once I receive it.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
